lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When Jezebel heard what had happened on Mount Carmel, she sent Elijah a deadly threat.

lines.speaker: jezebel
lines.text: By tomorrow, I will make your life like the lives of the prophets you have defeated!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Elijah was afraid. The prophet who had stood before Ahab now ran into the wilderness for his life.

lines.speaker: elijah
lines.text: I have had enough, LORD. Take my life. I am no better than my ancestors.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Exhausted, Elijah lay down beneath a broom bush and fell asleep. An angel touched him and told him to eat.

lines.speaker: angel
lines.text: Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The angel came again with food and water. Strengthened by it, Elijah travelled forty days and forty nights to Horeb, the mountain of God.
